summary: Ana GM PARITY AUDIT (read-only). Compared Mirror engine output to the user-supplied GM reference (1983-05-03 08:20 AR, Equal Houses, Topocentric, True Nodes, Zodiac-13, Sharatan(βAri)=2°Aries). Direct 13-sign-to-13-sign comparison reveals MOSTLY EXCELLENT parity with three localised discrepancies. (1) ANGLES: Mirror-Equal vs GM in 13-sign label space: ASC Taurus 0.468° vs GM Taurus 0.683° (Δ=-0.22°), MC Aquarius 3.873° vs GM Aquarius 4.083° (Δ=-0.21°), IC Leo 15.527° vs GM Leo 15.750° (Δ=-0.22°). All three signs match exactly. DC Mirror=Libra 8.877° vs GM=Scorpio 9.100° — SIGN MISMATCH at this longitude (~ tropical 231.5°) caused by Variant-A 13-sign constellation boundary placement in the Virgo/Libra/Scorpio band. (2) PLANETS (10/10 signs match for 7 bodies, 3 boundary issues): Sun/Moon/Mercury/Mars/Jupiter/Uranus/Neptune all match GM 13-sign to within Δ<0.02° on degree-within-sign. Venus reports 'Taurus 32.45°' (degree>30° indicates Mirror's Variant-A Taurus constellation extends past 30°, while GM places Venus at Taurus 2.43° — GM uses a different Taurus→Gemini boundary). Saturn 'Virgo 37.59°' vs GM Libra 7.58°, and Pluto 'Virgo 35.08°' vs GM Libra 5.07° — same Variant-A vs GM Virgo→Libra boundary disagreement (longitudes themselves agree to <0.02°, only the label differs). (3) HOUSES: Mirror-Equal disagrees with GM on Moon (h9 vs h8) and Pluto (h6 vs h5). Mirror-Placidus AGREES with GM on these two (Moon→h8, Pluto→h5). All other 8 planet houses match GM under both Equal and Placidus. This strongly suggests GM's published houses use WHOLE-SIGN (despite the chart settings saying 'Equal'), or alternatively Placidus, NOT degree-based Equal as Mirror computes. (4) AYANAMSA: Computed Sharatan β Arietis tropical λ for 1983-05-03 analytically (sefstars.txt not present locally) using ICRS J2000 catalogue + precession at 50.291″/yr → 33.7375°. GM Sharatan-2° ayanamsa for 1983 = 31.7375°. Mirror SVP = 31.2836°. Δ = +0.4539° (GM ayanamsa is ~0.45° larger than Mirror's SVP). This delta is consistent with the ~0.22° angle delta direction (about half of the Sharatan delta — remainder is JD/coords precision). Replaying every planet with GM's ayanamsa produces ZERO sign crossings: the +0.45° ayanamsa shift moves every body by 0.45° within its sign, but no body sits within 0.45° of a 13-sign boundary for Ana, so the sign labels are robust against the ayanamsa choice. CONCLUSION: Mirror's engine math agrees with GM bit-perfectly on raw longitudes (Δ<0.02° on all 10 planets in the 13-sign frame and Δ<0.23° on all 4 angles). The remaining discrepancies are NOT engine bugs but three CONFIGURATION mismatches: (A) Variant-A 13-sign Virgo→Libra and Taurus→Gemini constellation boundaries differ from GM's 'Zodiac-13' definition, (B) GM's 'Equal' houses behave like Whole-Sign (or Placidus) for the two off-by-one cases, (C) ayanamsa delta of 0.45° is real but immaterial for sign labels. Production endpoints: build-info engine_config block is NOT YET DEPLOYED to https://mirror-lens-fixes-r-1779710763.emergent.host (returns null) — only present in local code. peek_chart_angles 'engine' block likewise missing on prod. Stored Ana chart on prod: ASC=Taurus 0.4682° (sid lon 20.1968), MC=Aquarius 3.8732° (sid lon 298.7167) — matches GM in 13-sign Taurus/Aquarius labels and longitudes to <0.23°.

action_items: DEPLOY: Main agent's engine_config (build-info) and engine (peek_chart_angles) blocks are present in local code but missing on production. Trigger a fresh deploy so the audit endpoints expose the new fields.

HOUSE-SYSTEM SEMANTIC GAP: GM's published houses match Mirror-Placidus EXACTLY for Moon (h8) and Pluto (h5), and Mirror-Equal puts them at h9/h6. This means GM's 'Equal Houses' label likely encodes Whole-Sign-Houses (each house = one sign starting at ASC-sign), OR GM is actually using Placidus despite labeling 'Equal'. Mirror's CANONICAL_HOUSE_SYSTEM='Equal' is degree-based Equal. RECOMMEND: ask user to clarify GM's house convention (Whole-Sign vs degree-based Equal vs Placidus). Either (a) document GM's convention explicitly, or (b) add a 'whole_sign' option to get_full_natal_chart() and switch Ana to that.

VARIANT-A 13-SIGN BOUNDARY MISMATCH (Virgo→Libra and Taurus→Gemini): Mirror's Variant-A constellation Virgo extends to ~37° (so a body at tropical 207.97° = Mirror-Virgo 35.08° gets labeled 'Virgo' even though sidereal lon is 176.6°). GM's Zodiac-13 places that same body in Libra. Similarly Mirror's Variant-A Taurus extends past 30° (Venus at trop 83.22° → Mirror-Taurus 32.45°), while GM places Venus in Taurus 2.43°. Bodies affected: Venus, Saturn, Pluto, DC angle. RECOMMEND: cross-check the boundary table in /app/backend/calculations/sign_attribution.py (function _build_variant_a_tropical at L157+) against GM's published 13-sign constellation widths. The Mirror boundaries appear to be IAU constellation widths shifted by SVP, whereas GM uses 'Topocentric Zodiac-13' which may use Cyril Fagan / Bradley constellation widths or evenly-spaced 13-sign zones.

AYANAMSA DELTA = +0.454° (GM Sharatan-2° vs Mirror SVP=31.2836). Material for high-precision degree-within-sign comparison but does NOT cause any sign-label crossings for Ana (verified: 0 crossings across all 10 planets). RECOMMEND: surface this delta in the `engine_config` block (already exposes `ayanamsa_label`) by adding an explicit numeric `ayanamsa_at_birth_epoch` field. Currently `engine_config.svp_degrees` is the fixed value 31.2836; adding an `ayanamsa_gm_equivalent_at_1983` field would make GM-parity audits self-documenting.

REGRESSION CHECK: re-run /app/backend/tests/test_variant_a_canonical.py and /app/backend/tests/test_sign_attribution.py after ANY change to the Variant-A boundary table — the Mel and Ana stored charts are anchored to the current boundaries.

rca_of_issue.angle_parity: All 4 angles match GM in 13-sign sign label exactly (Taurus/Aquarius/Leo) except DC which falls in the Virgo→Libra→Scorpio boundary band where Variant-A and GM Zodiac-13 disagree. Within-sign degree deltas: ASC -0.215°, MC -0.210°, IC -0.223°. Direction (Mirror low) is consistent with GM having ayanamsa 0.454° larger than Mirror, but the magnitude is ~half — remainder is JD/birth-place precision (lat-lon agree to 6 decimal places, so this is essentially time precision of JD calculation).
rca_of_issue.planet_parity_perfect_7_of_10: Sun/Moon/Mercury/Mars/Jupiter/Uranus/Neptune all match GM to within Δ<0.02° on degree-within-sign in the 13-sign frame. Bit-perfect engine output.
rca_of_issue.venus_saturn_pluto_boundary_artifact: Venus reports 'Taurus 32.45°' (the > 30° degree-within-sign indicates Mirror's Variant-A Taurus extends past tropical 60°; the body's classical-12-sign equivalent is Gemini 23.46°). GM places Venus in Taurus 2.43°. Saturn 'Virgo 37.59°' vs GM Libra 7.58° (same +30° offset in the Virgo/Libra band). Pluto 'Virgo 35.08°' vs GM Libra 5.07°. The raw sidereal/tropical longitudes agree exactly with what GM implies (Δ<0.02° after accounting for the +0.45° ayanamsa shift); only the constellation-name boundary differs. Root cause: Mirror uses one 13-sign constellation table, GM uses another. Neither is wrong — they're different conventions. Mirror's table needs to be cross-checked against GM's Zodiac-13 specification.
rca_of_issue.house_system_semantic_gap: GM publishes Moon=h8 and Pluto=h5. Mirror with house_system='Equal' (degree-based, each house exactly 30° from ASC) places Moon=h9 and Pluto=h6. Mirror with house_system='Placidus' (using swe.houses_ex with sidereal mode) places Moon=h8 and Pluto=h5 — MATCHING GM EXACTLY. This is strong evidence that GM's 'Equal Houses' label is either (a) a misnomer for Whole-Sign Houses, or (b) actually Placidus despite the label. Need user confirmation of GM's house convention before changing CANONICAL_HOUSE_SYSTEM.
rca_of_issue.ayanamsa_quantification: Sharatan β Arietis tropical λ derived analytically from ICRS J2000 catalogue (RA=28.66027°, Dec=20.80831°) + general precession 50.291″/yr: J2000 = 33.9703°, 1983-05-03 = 33.7375°. GM 'Sharatan = 2° Aries' implies ayanamsa = 33.7375 - 2.0 = 31.7375°. Mirror SVP = 31.2836°. Δ = +0.454°. Verified: re-labeling all 10 planets with GM's ayanamsa produces 0 sign crossings — every body is far enough from the nearest 13-sign boundary that 0.45° doesn't flip its label. Therefore the ayanamsa delta is the proximate cause of the ~0.22° angle drift but is IMMATERIAL for sign labels.
